'''Zinska''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[prisoner]] who served as the [[floor manager]] for Level 5, Room 2's [[Unit Five-Two night shift|night shift unit]] at the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|facility]] on [[Narkina 5]].<ref name="N5" /> Zinska would regularly pass [[Kino Loy]], the day shift floor manager for Level 5, in the facility's bridge-corridors during shift change, which the two used as an opportunity to briefly discuss goings-on within the facility. When rumors began to spread about the deaths of 100 prisoners on [[Level 2 (Narkina 5)|Level 2]], Loy did not believe they were true until Zinska confirmed them.<ref name="NL!" /> During the [[Narkina 5 prison escape|uprising]] against the prison's staff, Zinska listened as Kino Loy made a facility-wide call to arms from a hijacked comms station, and subsequently led the men under his charge to join Loy and the prisoner [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor's]] desperate battle for freedom.<ref name="OWO">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>
